items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: Played Lord Beaverbrook's house and places like that.

ctx.x: Oh, well that was a hectic trip because we were pioneering, according to certain people. And it entailed quite a few little incidents. We would play in a theater and then play a dance -- go to play a dance or a party -- mostly a party -- private party.
We played for a party at the Prince of Wales -- for the Prince of Wales. Oh many parties. Played Lord Beaverbrook's house and places like that.
Barry Ulanov says (Inaudible) the Prince of Wales sat in with the band once.
